content.short: Grass is a decentralized DePIN protocol on Solana that allows users to monetize unused bandwidth for AI training.
content.description: Grass is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) on Solana that enables users to monetize their unused internet bandwidth. By running a node via a browser extension, participants contribute to a global network that scrapes and structures public web data for training AI models. The protocol uses zero-knowledge proofs to ensure data is sourced ethically without compromising user privacy. The network democratizes the AI data pipeline, rewarding users for resources provided to developers. As a leader in decentralized AI, Grass offers a scalable and transparent data solution.
